deprecations.reason: Client.query() is removed in v3.0. Replaced by Client.search(). In v3.0, the timeout parameter is mandatory.
Explicit unit naming convention (seconds). Default changed to 60s in v2, 30s in v3.
Default backoff reduced from 1000ms (v1) -> 500ms (v2) -> 250ms (v3) for lower p99 latency.
Replaced session expiration with OAuth2/JWT token TTL in seconds.
Direct session login endpoint deprecated in favor of granular scoped OAuth token endpoint (/v3/auth/token) via Client.auth(token_ttl_sec=3600).
Direct session login endpoint deprecated in favor of granular scoped OAuth token endpoint. Default TTL lowered from 7200s to 3600s.
dispatch() is removed in v3.0. submit_jobs() replaces payloads parameter with job_list and concurrency with max_concurrency, adding auto_retry_failed.
Stream.feed() is removed in v3.0 and replaced by Stream.subscribe(). Parameters buffer_len renamed to max_buffer_size (default 1024), ping_interval changed to keep_alive_ping_ms (5000ms).
Config.get_config() is removed in v3.0 in favor of Config.load_settings(). Parameter path renamed to file_path with env_override support.
Webhook.subscribe() is removed in v3.0 and replaced by register_listener(). Parameter callback_url renamed to target_url, requires signature_algorithm.
